Tina S.: FYI — eu-west3 GPU attach failures climbing again since ~1722229900. Pods report "waiting for device" and attach timeouts.
Ravi N.: seeing it. NVMe latencies spike to 200-400ms on some hosts. iostat shows write stalls, qdepth near 128.
Liam O.: janitor scrub window started at 1722229800. backlog up on a few hosts (hot volumes). Hypothesis: scrub + hot writes -> qdepth saturation -> attach block.
Tina S.: quick mitigation?
Liam O.: throttle janitor to concurrency=1 on affected hosts and set per-device batch=32. Also enable device-plugin attach-retry to 5s backoff. Can roll in 3m.
ops-bot: [ALERT] gpu_attach_fail_rate eu-west3 > threshold (50 failures / 10m).
Ravi N.: rolling canary to 8 hosts now. dashboards pinned.
Tina S.: watch GPU idle time and attach success. If clear in 10m, widen rollout.
Ravi N.: attach failures down: 50 -> 9 in last 10m. Will follow up with INFRA-4632 for smarter janitor pacing and IO-priority for attach.
Tina S.: add cost note: blocked GPUs ~1.1k GPU-minutes. Consider cross-region spill if this repeats.
